description: This file defines the PushRegistrationManager actor responsible for managing push notification registration payloads, including handling relay and direct transport methods, encoding payloads, and dealing with relay registration logic.

classes.name: PushRegistrationManager
classes.description: An actor that manages push notification registration payloads, supporting relay and direct transport modes, with methods for creating registration payloads asynchronously.

methods.name: makeGatewayRegistrationPayload
methods.description: Creates a registration payload for push notifications, either direct or relay, based on the current build configuration.

methods.name: makeRelayPayload
methods.description: Constructs a relay registration payload, performing validation and possibly reusing cached registration state.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a relay handle has expired based on its expiry timestamp.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA256 hash of a string and returns it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: normalizeTokenSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes the token suffix by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes a given Encodable payload into a JSON string.
